title: Experimental Research on Water Jet Devices for Borehole Hydraulic Mining
author: Jiwei Wen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ppfdmjn

steps.title: Test Water Jet Striking Force
steps.instruction: Measure the striking force of the water jets using the specified nozzles and conditions.

substeps.instruction: Fix the detection mechanism of the water jet's striking force in the angle-adjustable sample basket.
Perform tests using the straight cone nozzle and the self-excited oscillation pulsed jet nozzle, adjusting conditions according to Table 7.
Record the corresponding high-pressure water jet striking force data synchronously for analysis.

steps.title: Break Oil Shale with Cone Nozzle
steps.instruction: Use the straight cone nozzle to break oil shale samples and measure the resulting damage.

substeps.instruction: Unload the striking force detection mechanism from the angle-adjustable sample basket.
Fix an oil shale sample in the angle-adjustable sample basket.
Break the oil shale sample using the straight cone nozzle based on the conditions in Table 9.
Observe and record experimental phenomena and data.
Measure the sizes of the broken holes on the oil shale surface using a standard vernier caliper.

steps.title: Break Oil Shale with Pulsed Jet
steps.instruction: Use the self-excited oscillation pulsed jet nozzle to break oil shale samples and measure the resulting damage.

substeps.instruction: Unload the self-resonating cavitating jet nozzle and install the self-excited oscillation pulsed jet nozzle.
Replace the broken oil shale sample with a new one in the angle-adjustable sample basket.
Break the oil shale sample using the self-excited oscillation pulsed jet nozzle based on the conditions in Table 11.
Observe and record experimental phenomena and data.
Measure the sizes of the broken holes on the oil shale surface using a standard vernier caliper.

steps.title: Break Oil Shale with Cavitating Jet
steps.instruction: Use the self-resonating cavitating jet nozzle to break oil shale samples and measure the resulting damage.

substeps.instruction: Unload the straight cone nozzle and install the self-resonating cavitating jet nozzle.
Replace the broken oil shale sample with a new one in the angle-adjustable sample basket.
Break the oil shale sample using the self-resonating cavitating jet nozzle based on the conditions in Table 10.
Observe and record experimental phenomena and data.
Measure the sizes of the broken holes on the oil shale surface using a standard vernier caliper.

steps.title: Analyze Experimental Data
steps.instruction: Collate and process the data from all experiments to provide scientific explanations for the observed phenomena.
